title: This Ex-Republican Professor Flipped a Trump Seat Blue – and He Wants to End Aid to Israel
author: Team Zeteo
content:
**Mehdi** has interviewed a lot of Democrats over the years -
[moderates,](https://zeteo.com/p/mark-warner-elections-iran-israel-aipac-
trump?utm_source=publication-search) [progressives,](https://zeteo.com/p/is-
chris-van-hollen-running-for-president) and [democratic
socialists.](https://zeteo.com/p/firs-gen-z-congresswoman-melat-
kiros?utm_source=publication-search)

But never before has he interviewed someone like incoming Democratic
congressman **Don Leonard** - an ex-conservative populist from Ohio who just
flipped a red seat blue in the midterms after previously being
[arrested](https://www.nbc4i.com/news/local-news/grove-city/congressional-
candidate-arrested-at-protest/) for his activism. He is [shaking things
up](https://www.axios.com/2026/11/11/don-leonard-ohio-democrat-house-jeffries)
for House Democrats already, describing the United States as in **" crisis,"
**denouncing the **" oligarchs" **and Democratic neoliberals, and warning that
democracy may not survive the 2028 election if the Democrats don't take action
now.

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

In this interview, Mehdi asks the contrarian, outspoken freshman Democrat
about the [backlash](https://www.politico.com/live-
updates/2026/11/10/congress/don-leonard-hakeem-jeffries-speaker-vote-
democrats-01158321) he's received from senior party members after saying that
current House Minority Leader Hakeem Jeffries does not have his vote for
Speaker of the House. That is, he explains,
[unless](https://thehill.com/the-120/6222534-don-leonard-jeffries-speaker/)
Jeffries commits to ending Citizens United and dark money in politics through
a 28th Amendment by 2028, and also holds a floor vote on ending all U.S. aid
to Israel.

**" It kills me to be sitting at reception after reception after reception of
Democrats clinking the wine glasses and taking victory laps as if there was
anything about what was happening here in Washington that was working,"
**Leonard says.

Although Leonard doesn't view himself as a progressive, he and Mehdi discuss a
wide range of his clearly progressive goals, including replacing ICE and
ending aid to Israel, and how learning about the Holocaust as a child
influenced his current opposition to the Gaza genocide. Leonard tells Mehdi:
**" Israel 1.0 is a failed experiment."**
